channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 12 Aug: Harare light showers · high 21° / low 11°
item.description: Harare: high 21°, low 11° (light showers) · Bulawayo: high 13°, low 9° (overcast) · Mutare: high 17°, low 12° (heavy drizzle) · Gweru: high 14°, low 9° (light drizzle) · Masvingo: high 14°, low 11° (drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 27°, low 13° (light drizzle) Tsumo yezuva: Zviro zviyedzwa.
